| check | result |

Not covered by that pass:

- Ollama and the model: no environment deploys one yet, so /healthz's ollama check is expected to fail and is not gated on
- agent diagnosis and proposals: they need the model
- the backup image: published, not deployed to staging
- Slack approval: staging has no Slack app of its own

What the gate checked when the promotion was started:

```

sha-06b64ba may be promoted to prod.
```

## Rollback plan

Prod runs `sha-c8e3dee` today, so that is the version to go back to.

```
gh workflow run rollback.yml --ref main -f tag=sha-c8e3dee -f reason="<why>"
```

Going back crosses no database migration.

Last measured: about 80 seconds from merging the rollback pull request to every service healthy (staging, 2026-10-09, ADR-0034). Prod's own time has not been measured. Runbook: `docs/runbooks/rollback-prod.md`.
